attchmntText: Shree Rama Multi-Tech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

Significant movement in price has been observed in Shree Rama Multi-Tech Limited. Shree Rama Multi-Tech Limited has submitted their response.
